facts.text: Detector is the upstream client class for one SLS detector; its constructor takes the host, the control port and the stop port and keeps one Connection object for each
DEFAULT_CTRL_PORT is 1952 and DEFAULT_STOP_PORT is 1953
The Mythen layout comment draws 6 modules, 10 chips per module and 128 channels per chip
Connection.connect creates a socket, sets TCP_NODELAY and connects without setting a timeout; Connection.close closes the socket
Each control-port call runs inside 'with self.conn_ctrl' and each stop-port call inside 'with self.conn_stop', so every call connects and closes the detector's shared Connection object
request_reply writes the request, reads a ResultType and raises SLSError on ResultType.FAIL
run_status is a stop_property that calls protocol.get_run_status on the stop connection
RunStatus names are IDLE, ERROR, WAITING, FINISHED, TRANSMITTING and RUNNING
start_acquisition sends START_AND_READ_ALL when keep_connection is true and otherwise sends START_ACQUISITION through request_reply
stop_acquisition sends STOP_ACQUISITION through request_reply on the stop connection
Detector.stop_acquisition uses the stop connection and Detector.start_acquisition the control connection with keep_connection=False
Detector.acquire() runs an Acquisition context with progress_interval=None and yields each frame

The raw acquisition generator keeps the control connection open while it starts the acquisition and fetches frames; an SLSError is re-raised unless the Acquisition's own stop() set _stopped, and any other exception stops the acquisition before the control socket is closed because the comment says otherwise the detector hangs
Acquisition.stop sets _stopped and calls the detector's stop_acquisition
fetch_frames yields frames while fetch_frame returns OK and ends on FINISHED; a FAIL raises SLSError, which the comment says may come from an acquisition error or a stop
update_client returns data_bytes and dynamic_range among the client information
_to_numpy_meta decodes 24 and 32-bit frames as '<i4', 16-bit frames as '<i2' and 8-bit frames as '<i'
The timer wire value is an integer and acquisition time, frame period and delay after trigger are converted from seconds to nanoseconds on write and back to seconds on read
get_time_left converts acquisition time, frame period, delay after trigger, actual time and measurement time from nanoseconds to seconds
The client exposes exposure_time, nb_frames, nb_cycles, delay_after_trigger and frame_period as properties over the timer types
The detector threshold is held in eV
The energy threshold client property reads and writes module -1
The protocol comment says mod_nb -1 means ALL for the energy threshold
DetectorSettings names include STANDARD, FAST and HIGHGAIN; DetectorType names include MYTHEN
get_nb_modules queries the module count by dimension and get_module_serial_number queries a module's serial number through get_id
set_energy_threshold and the timer encoder pass the value into the request struct without checking a numeric range

safe_state.description: acquisition stop requested with the native stop_acquisition command (STOP_ACQUISITION on the stop port, acknowledged by the detector's reply; a FAIL reply raises); the run status read after the command is reported, not an independently sensed quiescence
